docs.title: Android + Java Tutorial
docs.text:
Welcome! 🚀 This documentation explains Android development fundamentals using Java.

Each section contains explanations and runnable code snippets that you can try in Android Studio.

docs.title: AndroidManifest.xml
docs.text:
Defines app components and permissions.

<manifest package="com.example.app">
  <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
  <application android:label="@string/app_name">
    <activity android:name=".MainActivity">
      <intent-filter>
        <action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/>
        <category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>
      </intent-filter>
    </activity>
  </application>
</manifest>

docs.title: SQLiteOpenHelper
docs.text:
public class DBHelper extends SQLiteOpenHelper {
    public DBHelper(Context ctx){ super(ctx, "notes.db", null, 1); }
    @Override public void onCreate(SQLiteDatabase db){
        db.execSQL("CREATE TABLE notes(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT)");
    }
    @Override public void onUpgrade(SQLiteDatabase db, int oldV, int newV){
        db.execSQL("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS notes");
        onCreate(db);
    }
}

docs.title: Insert / Query
docs.text:
SQLiteDatabase db = new DBHelper(this).getWritableDatabase();
ContentValues cv = new ContentValues();
cv.put("title", "Hello");
db.insert("notes", null, cv);

docs.title: Fundamentals
docs.text: Android apps are built using four main components:

docs.title: Activities
docs.text:
• Represents a single screen.
  • Lifecycle: onCreate(), onStart(), onResume(), onPause(), onStop(), onDestroy().
Intent i = new Intent(MainActivity.this, SecondActivity.class);
startActivity(i);

docs.title: Services
docs.text:
• Run in the background.
  • Example: music playback.
public class MyService extends Service {
    @Override
    public int onStartCommand(Intent intent, int flags, int startId) {
        new Thread(() -> {
            // background task
            stopSelf();
        }).start();
        return START_NOT_STICKY;
    }
    @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return null; }
}

docs.title: Broadcast Receivers
docs.text:
• Listen for system-wide messages (battery low, network change).
public class BatteryReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {
    @Override public void onReceive(Context c, Intent i) {
        Toast.makeText(c, "Battery low!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }
}
